title: Automate changelog and onboard Penumbra-X 13B v1.0 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Context: This PR adds Penumbra-X 13B v1.0 to the model registry with production-ready metadata and performance profiles, and extends the changelog/release-notes automation to include model onboarding metadata automatically. Motivation: onboarding has been manual and error-prone; performance profiles need to be ingested consistently for runtime routing and cost estimates. This change bundles three things: 1) model metadata and canonical performance profiles for Penumbra-X 13B v1.0 (latency/throughput numbers across batch sizes and sequence lengths), 2) automated changelog generation hooks so adding a model produces a changelog entry and updates the registry changelog JSON/YAML, and 3) small docs updates and tests. Implementation highlights: - Added registry entry file models/penumbra-x/13b/v1.0/metadata.yaml with model provenance, tokenizer, architecture hints, quantization recommendations, and KVS compatibility notes. - Added perf profile models/penumbra-x/13b/v1.0/perf_profiles.json with measured p50/p95 latencies, token throughput, memory usage across selected instance types and batch sizes. - Implemented scripts/tools/changelog/auto_changelog.py that converts new model metadata into structured changelog entries and appends to registry_changelog.yaml; integrated into the model onboarding Makefile/CI job. - Added unit+integration tests under tests/model_registry to validate schema and the changelog patch behavior. - Small docs updates in docs/models.md and examples/penumbra-x-quickstart.md. Rollout notes: the automation is opt-in via a model manifest flag "auto_changelog: true" to avoid surprise updates for legacy entries. Backwards compatibility: unchanged for existing models. See release_notes for user-facing summary.

Improvements: faster PR perf harness and tests for changelog automation. No breaking changes.
